purpose: Three independent MPDS diagnoses of the reported failed cubic-PBA coprecipitation experiment before selecting a prospective process intervention.

input.topic: Failure analysis and improvement strategies for synthesizing Prussian Blue Analogue (PBA) particles with cubic morphology

implementation.interpretation: A new standardized MPDS diagnostic series using the preserved evidence pools and current auditable MPDS implementation, not an exact software replication of the undocumented historical run.

analysis_lock.analysis_text: Final moderator synthesis only; persona-generation text and debate turns are retained for audit but excluded from consensus coding.
analysis_lock.rank_rule: Record the moderator's highest-priority causal bottleneck as Rank 1 and retain up to two additional bottlenecks in stated priority order. Do not infer a Rank 1 from rhetorical emphasis if no priority is stated; code as mixed/unclear.
analysis_lock.consensus_rule: Declare a consensus primary bottleneck only if the same primary category is Rank 1 in at least two of three independent runs; otherwise report no stable consensus.
analysis_lock.intervention_rule: Do not select the modified recipe until all three runs and consensus coding are complete. The first validation experiment should alter one process factor linked to the consensus bottleneck while holding the remaining reported synthesis conditions fixed.
analysis_lock.claim_boundary: The three MPDS runs test diagnostic reproducibility. They do not prove causality or experimental reproducibility.
